cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Robot calligraphy record. All motion is issued through the standard client.
Trajectory commands and returned observations are archived in /app/runs.
Run with a JSON file containing world XYZ waypoints (metres) and durations.
"""
import sys,json,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output'); RUNS=Path('/app/runs')
Q=[0,1,0,0]
def execute(r,points,label,dt=.05):
    obs=r.get_obs(cameras=[],video='none')
    start=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10]); rows=[]
    for p in points:
        end=np.array(p[:3]); n=max(1,int(round(p[3]/dt)))
        rows.extend([list(start+(end-start)*i/n)+Q for i in range(1,n+1)])
        start=end
    path=RUNS/label;path.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    np.save(path/'targets.npy',rows)
    for k in range(0,len(rows),180):
        before=r.status()
        try:
            res=r.submit('ee_pose',rows[k:k+180],dt=dt,cameras=['practice_cam','canvas_cam','side_cam'],video='frames',video_fps=2,note=label)
        except Exception:
            print('CALL ERROR; resuming status',r.wait_ready(), 'before',before,flush=True)
            raise
        res.save(str(path/str(k)))
        for cam,a in res.last.items(): Image.fromarray(a).save(OUT/(cam+'.png'))
        print(label,k,'pose',np.round(res.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],6),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),'timeleft',res.meta.get('time_left_s'),flush=True)
        if res.stopped: raise RuntimeError('partial call')
    return res
if __name__=='__main__':
    r=Robot()
    data=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    execute(r,data['points'],data['label'])
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=True)
    o.save(str(RUNS/data['label']/'obs'))
    for cam,a in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(a).save(OUT/(cam+'.png'))
